video_title: Grant Hill Makes The Case For LeBron’s Cleveland Return

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson wants to see LeBron James return to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: Selfishly as a fan, I'd love to see him go back to Cleveland.
quotes.quote: Selfishly as a fan, I'd love to see him go back to Cleveland. That's where it started. Obviously, the team has knocked on the door. I just don't know if they have enough. Where they land is who they are. And here's the thing: the East is going to be harder next year.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson expects the Eastern Conference to be more competitive
quotes.excerpt: I know they traded Jaylen Brown, but Boston, if they're healthy, they're going to be really good.
quotes.quote: I know they traded Jaylen Brown, but Boston, if they're healthy, they're going to be really good. And I think part of it too was you had a draft that was supposed to be a great draft this year, so a lot of teams were tanking. Teams weren't as bad as people thought.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues the Eastern Conference is now highly competitive
quotes.excerpt: It's not just like, oh, the West is that much better than the East, though the playing field has evened out.
quotes.quote: It's not just like, oh, the West is that much better than the East, though the playing field has evened out. The East is stacked.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson reiterates his preference for LeBron James in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I'd like to see LeBron in Cleveland though.
quotes.quote: I'd like to see LeBron in Cleveland though.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins believes Minnesota is the best fit for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I think the best fit for him is Minnesota for one year.
quotes.quote: I think the best fit for him is Minnesota for one year. You put LeBron to fill that void with Julius Randle missing, with LaMelo, Jaden McDaniels, Rudy, and I go coming in off the bench. We don't know when Dante is going to come back. I love the pickup of Trey Lyles. People don't talk about that, but they are going to find out who Trey Lyles is in a minute this season. I like that for LeBron.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson praises Channing Frye and Jared Dudley as teammates
quotes.excerpt: Two of my favorite teammates, Channing and Jared Dudley. They both played with LeBron.
quotes.quote: Two of my favorite teammates, Channing and Jared Dudley. They both played with LeBron in different, Channing in Cleveland, Jared in LA, and they talked just about like he's a glue guy. And you think of a glue guy as a role player, but with the Olympic team, always the first on the bus, always the first in the meeting, and his voice. We had a relatively quiet team, but the power of his voice to say what needs to be said. I was blown away. I see what he does on the court, but just in the locker room, in the huddles, wherever he goes, even at this point, he's going to have an impact in my opinion.
